messages:
oncall-bot: Incident triggered — PROD model-serving cluster 'infer-prod-eu' 95th latency > 1.2s for 6m. Alert id: INC-20260315-4421
sarah: saw the alert, jumping in. which pool? kv-cache look suspect?
ajay: metrics show KV cache size spiking + continuous batching rate up ~3x vs baseline. link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/model-infer
olivia: confirmed errors from edge: increased 502s on embedding endpoint during spike. customer impact — high volume embed customers (org: datify) saw partial failures
mike: tagging oncall-pager: can we throttle batching or reduce batch_max_tokens? quick mitigation idea: reduce continuous batching window from 30ms -> 10ms
sarah: +1 on temp throttle. I'll push config to runtime with override policy 'hotfix/kv-warmup-hysteresis'
sarah: running command:
```
redwoodctl config set runtime.batch.continuous_window_ms=10 --env prod --selector pool=infer-prod-eu
redwoodctl deploy --hotfix --selector pool=infer-prod-eu
```
ops-bot: Deploy started: hotfix/kv-warmup-hysteresis by sarah — CI pass. rolling 12 nodes; estimated 2m
ajay: watching autoscaler — HPA CPU target 60% currently. but CPU spiky because batching keeps filling cache and warmup keeps spinning new pods
sarah: also applying hysteresis to HPA to avoid thrash. plan: set stabilizationWindowSeconds=120 and scaleDownDelaySeconds=180
sarah: k8s patch:
```
kubectl patch hpa infer-worker --type='merge' -p '{"spec": {"behavior": {"scaleDown": {"stabilizationWindowSeconds": 120}}}}' -n prod
```
olivia: results 30s after deploy: 95th latency down to 780ms, errors down 70% :tada:
mike: but cost telemetry shows a short spike — cache fill caused more tokens served before hotfix fully rolled out
ajay: monitoring KV cache hit ratio — it dipped then recovering. PV usage for kv-cache pods peaked, some eviction warnings
sarah: adding temporary kv cache cap: runtime.kv.max_prefixes=20000 to throttle runaway prefixes
sarah: command:
```
redwoodctl config set runtime.kv.max_prefixes=20000 --env prod
```
deploy-bot: Config change applied to infer-prod-eu (audited by sarah)
ops-bot: Autoscaler patched, batching window override applied, kv cap set — observing for 10m
olivia: customer comms: Datify support triaged, they saw 5% of requests 502 for ~4m. I've opened a ticket and sent initial note with mitigation status
ajay: note — the root cause looks like continuous batching + cold KV warmups. pattern: many low-latency new prefixes triggered full KV population which amplified batching latency and spiked throughput -> HPA ramp -> more cold caches
sarah: filing follow-up: will schedule a postmortem runbook and add a canary test that simulates cold-prefix ramp to capture this regression earlier
mike: runbook items: (1) alert on kv_prefix_fill_rate, (2) add soft cap backpressure at admission per-prefix, (3) add metrics scoreboard for batching queue length
sarah: handoff to night-oncall @olivia in 30m. I'll summarize:
- Incident: KV cache blowup + continuous batching warmup -> latency + 502s
- Mitigations: reduced continuous_window_ms, set kv.max_prefixes, patched HPA scaleDown stabilization
- Impact: partial 502s to embedding customers (not full outage), cost spike during 10m window
- Next actions: postmortem, canary test, per-prefix backpressure
olivia: acknowledged, I'll monitor until 0200 UTC and escalate if any regression. assigning follow-up ticket PM-3482
oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260315-4421 marked 'mitigated' by sarah — 02:03 UTC. Please attach logs and timeline to ticket PM-3482
sarah: attaching short logs excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T01:46:21Z] kv-cache: prefix_count=24012
[2026-03-15T01:46:36Z] batching: continuous_rate=316r/s -> 912r/s
[2026-03-15T01:47:05Z] hpa: desired_replicas=24 -> 48
[2026-03-15T01:48:20Z] errors: embedding_502=143
```
olivia: noted. handing over pager + dashboard to @mike for overlap 01:50-02:10 UTC. pinging oncall rotation channel
mike: taking overlap. leaving playbook notes in PM-3482. :thumbsup:
